# `Q-3-34` — Unprocessed Delete Markup

> Delete editorial markup `[-- ...]` was not desugared to a
> Span during postprocessing.

## What this means

Quarto's CriticMarkup-inspired deletion construct `[-- ...]`
is parsed as a `Delete` AST node. Postprocessing rewrites it
as a `Span` with the `.quarto-delete` class before the writer runs.
This error fires when a raw `Delete` node reaches the writer.

This is a defensive guard. The condition is a pipeline bug, not
a source-level mistake.

## Why this happens

Two known triggers:

- **A Lua filter ran after postprocessing** and reintroduced a
  `Delete` AST node.
- **A bug in the postprocessor** that misses some deletions.

## How to fix

If a custom filter is in use, ensure it does not produce
`Delete` AST nodes after postprocessing. If no filter is in use,
report the document at the Quarto issue tracker.

## Related

- `Q-3-33`, `Q-3-35`, `Q-3-36` — same condition for `Insert`,
  `Highlight`, and `EditComment` markup respectively.
